obfuscation_indicators: known and unknown risks and uncertainties
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantitatively supported, reporting sales, margins, expenses, taxes, commodity costs, and debt status. Risk is moderated by favorable operating performance and a debt-free position, but uncertainties remain around commodity and labor costs, estimates, valuation allowances, insurance liabilities, and one-time specialty product sales. The extensive forward-looking disclaimer and broad risk-factor list are largely standard boilerplate.
